summary: Key-binding array removal with shift-down. Selects one of two key-binding arrays (dword_7CD2B8 or dword_7CD470) based on bit 2 of a1, ORs a2 into the dword at (a3 + 1149960185), reads the binding slot v5[a5], then removes it: when a5 >= 103 the slot is just reset to -1, otherwise the tail of the array is shifted down one slot (qmemcpy) and the last slot v5[103] is reset to -1. Returns the previously stored binding value.

operations.description: OR a2 into the dword at (a3 + 1149960185) and store the result back.
Default the array base v5 to &dword_7CD2B8.
When (a1 & 4) == 0, re-select the alternate array base v5 = &dword_7CD470; otherwise keep dword_7CD2B8.
Read result = v5[a5], the binding value currently stored at the slot being removed.
When a5 >= 103, clear the slot directly: v5[a5] = -1, with no shift.
Otherwise shift the array tail down: qmemcpy(&v5[a5], &v5[a5 + 1], 4 * (103 - a5)) moves the trailing slots toward the head to close the removed slot.
After the shift, reset the last array slot to the empty sentinel: v5[103] = -1.
Return result, the binding value that was removed from slot a5.
